stories.title: North Wales rail and bus programme wins two awards and a highly commended
stories.summary: The programme behind more trains on the North Wales Main Line and contactless ticketing at stations across the region has won two awards. Network North Wales, led by Transport for Wales (TfW), won the Delivering for the Customer and Acting as One Team: Infrastructure Delivery categories at the Rail Cymru Spotlight Rail Awards on Thursday

stories.title: North Wales Police chief to face MPs over plans to merge police forces
stories.summary: North Wales Police Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman will be questioned by MPs next week over UK Government plans that could see her force merged into a larger one. stories.title: Power cut hits part of Shotton and Aston
stories.summary: Update, 22:09 13 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report:Part of Shotton and Aston is without power this evening after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 10.39pm. stories.title: Online groomer jailed for 30 years at Chester Crown Court after police trace 70 victims
stories.summary: A man who posed online as a teenage boy called Reece to groom and blackmail girls has been jailed at Chester Crown Court after police traced 70 of his victims across the UK.
